page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.26xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz across an x86_64 architecture. The instance delivers 104 dedicated vCPUs paired with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per vCPU core. It operates without dedicated GPU acceleration hardware.

In terms of I/O, the instance features a baseline network throughput of 25 Gbps to handle high-volume inter-service communication and remote storage access. Local disk storage is not bundled with this server type, meaning persistent file systems and databases must rely entirely on remote network-attached block storage solutions. Zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

From an architectural perspective, the large core count and sizable memory footprint allow high parallel throughput for consolidated compute environments. The resource profile avoids the cost overhead associated with specialized hardware such as GPUs or onboard NVMe arrays, offering balanced resource efficiency for horizontally or vertically scaling enterprise workloads. Suitable applications include multi-threaded batch processing, high-concurrency enterprise web serving, microservices aggregation nodes, and large-scale relational or in-memory databases.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.26xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server offering dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors with 104 vCPUs at 2.5 GHz on x86_64 architecture. Configured with 384.0 GB of system memory, it maintains a balanced memory density of 3.69 GB per core. The server operates without integrated GPU hardware and provides no local disk storage, necessitating external network-attached storage for stateful workloads. Network connectivity is supported by a 25 Gbps baseline bandwidth, facilitating high-throughput data transfer across distributed infrastructure. With its high thread count and large memory capacity, the instance is structurally suited for scale-up application environments, heavy web serving tiers, continuous integration pipelines, batch processing tasks, and large enterprise databases operating on networked storage.
